Body.Content:
Commercial Journeys helps information workers stay on top of their most important work when browsing in Microsoft Edge. Powered by AI, it proactively surfaces unfinished, new, and recurring tasks on the Copilot new tab page- with context-rich cards that explain why each task matters now. One click opens a guided execution flow that delivers ready-to-use outputs (emails, documents, presentations, and more), so users can complete their unfinished work faster with higher quality. This feature will be available to users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium license in Edge.

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
